title: Oscar and the Orchard Revisited
author: Mirabel Galloway
blurb: Astrid Montrose, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
